Name: Leah Dating Enhanced (Chinese)
Author: qtytqtyt
Description:
=== 简介 / Description ===

莉亚恋爱增强（中文版）
Leah Dating Enhanced (Chinese)

本模组为星露谷物语中莉亚（Leah）的恋爱期体验填补空白。从送花束到结婚之间，你可以自由进出她的小屋、邀请她跟随散步、触发过夜剧情、被村民调侃你们的恋情、收到她的过夜后情书，以及解锁 45 条只在恋爱期出现的日常专属对话。结婚后所有功能自动关闭。无存档残留。纯中文，仅需 SMAPI。

This mod fills the dating-phase gap for Leah in Stardew Valley — the period between giving her a bouquet and marrying her. You can freely enter her cottage, invite her for walks, trigger sleepover events, be teased by villagers about your relationship, receive love letters from her, and unlock 45 dating-exclusive daily dialogue lines. All features disable after marriage. Zero save pollution. Chinese language only. Requires SMAPI.


=== 使用方法 / How to use ===

进入莉亚小屋：恋爱中直接右键她家门即可进入
邀请约会：恋爱中靠近莉亚，按 G 键（可在 config.json 中修改）
同伴交互：跟随中右键莉亚 → 弹出菜单（聊天 / 送她回家 / 继续走）
过夜触发：晚 8 点后带跟随中的莉亚进入你的农舍
村民调侃：跟随中右键任意村民
情书接收：过夜后次日查看邮箱

Enter cottage: Right-click her door while dating
Invite date: Press G (configurable) near Leah while dating
Companion menu: Right-click Leah while she's following you
Sleepover: Enter your farmhouse after 8 PM with Leah following
Villager tease: Right-click any villager while Leah is following
Love letters: Check your mailbox the morning after a sleepover


=== 语言 / Language ===

本模组所有对话、情书、村民调侃均为简体中文。不提供英文翻译。
This mod is Chinese (Simplified) only. No English translation provided.
非中文玩家如需英文版请自行翻译 ModEntry.cs 后重新编译。
For English, translate the dialogue strings in ModEntry.cs and recompile.


=== 前置 / Requirements ===

- SMAPI 4.5.0+
- Stardew Valley 1.6.15+
- 无需其他任何 mod / No other mods required


=== 鸣谢 / Credits ===

参考 Stardew Squad 模组 (Isalda/the-stardew-squad) 的跟随算法。
Companion following approach inspired by Stardew Squad (Isalda/the-stardew-squad).
